LAB abstract profiles, CMYK device links and corresponding color conversion remain functional stillneeded; this increment exports global RGB only. General CSP/ICC native import and Photoshop interchange descriptors remain unsupported.

Some legacy 3DL readers infer output bit depth from the maximum stored value, making dark tables ambiguous. Native Photato scale metadata preserves its own tables, but does not prove compatibility with every external reader.

Existing global-stack restrictions on spatial masks, groups, pixel overlays, clipping, dither/Dissolve, Grain and neighborhood effects remain. Current full-suite failures and prior Debug crashes remain recorded; no current optimized/universal/full-suite/physical/Photoshop qualification is claimed.
